## Loading Data

```{r}
#| message: false
load(here::here("data", "team_results.Rdata"))

library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary)
library(gtsummary)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-one
#| tbl-cap: "Men's March Madness Team Characteristics Stratified by Number of Championships won from 2008-2004"
tbl_summary(
	team_results,
	by = CHAMP, 
	include = c (GAMES, WINPERCENT, PAKE, PAKERANK, PASE, PASERANK, TOP2),
	label = list(
		GAMES ~ "Tournament Games Played" ,
		WINPERCENT ~ "Winning Percent", 
		PAKE ~ "Performance Against Komputer Expectations (PAKE)" ,
		PAKERANK ~ "PAKE Rank" ,
		PASE ~ "Performance Against Seed Expectations (PASE)",
		PASERANK ~ "PASE Rank",
		TOP2 ~ "Times Team was 1 or 2 Seed"
	),
	missing_text = "Missing"
)
```
